title: Compose Service Classification Catalogue
description: Semantic catalogue for classifying historical React Compose service candidates and deriving USF dev, test, staging, and production Compose realisations. Generated Compose files are derivative and not semantic authority.
aiGuidance: Classify every historical React Compose service before deriving Compose. Do not treat generated Compose as authority or infer production readiness from it.

environmentDefinitions.purpose: Realise and exercise semantic definitions quickly.

environmentDefinitions.purpose: Exercise semantic definitions against real backing products.
environmentDefinitions.defaultModel: Clean-room environment rebuilt and seeded every run.
environmentDefinitions.requirement: Claims beyond in-memory semantics require real products or an explicitly approved shared control-plane service.

environmentDefinitions.defaultModel: Real backing products with persistent data seeded once or allowed to evolve.
environmentDefinitions.requirement: Must prove persistence, upgrade safety, migrations, observability, access posture, operational workflows, and larger-corpus behaviour.
External managed providers or cloud-native resources may replace local Compose only when explicitly recorded.
